test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

For old time’s sake

options.text: To be friends with an old person
Because of sentimental memories of the past

solution:
The correct answer is **"Because of sentimental memories of the past."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"for old time's sake" **means to do something or be nostalgic about something because of sentimental memories of the past.
 
• It is often used when people want to revisit a place or activity that they used to enjoy
